## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change and why? Keep it short. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] refactor — internal change, no behavior diff
- [ ] docs — documentation
- [ ] chore — tooling / CI / deps
- [ ] perf — performance
- [ ] test — tests only

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit subject (e.g. `feat(api): ...`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` clean
- [ ] `uv run mypy src` clean
- [ ] `uv run pytest --cov` passes locally
- [ ] Docs / README updated if behavior changed
